reviewEntries.name: Abhishek Kumar
reviewEntries.title: Review of Babaji Misthan - The Original "Balushahi Shop"
reviewEntries.comment: “The Original and the Best: Babaji Misthan is the shop that truly defines the authentic Balushahi taste of Runni Saidpur. A true landmark for mithai lovers in Bihar.”

reviewEntries.name: Mahtab Alam
reviewEntries.comment: “One of the many shops offering the locally popular Balushahi, a type of Rasgulla of dark saffron color, has the taste little different from Kalajamun or even Gulabjamun.”

reviewEntries.name: Gaurav
reviewEntries.comment: “Baba Misthan Mithapur kaafi achha sweet shop hai. Yahan ke mithai fresh, tasty aur reasonable price par milte hain. Shop clean rehti hai aur staff ka behaviour bhi friendly hai. Local logon ke liye ek trusted jagah hai.”
